app.name: Peec AI
app.description: Berlin-based AI search visibility (GEO/AEO) analytics platform that tracks how brands appear in answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI assistants.

observations.note: Company press release (GlobeNewswire, Nov 2, 2026; republished by the Manila Times on Nov 3, https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/11/03/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/peec-ai-doubles-revenue-in-six-months-to-hit-20m-arr/2459810): Peec AI 'has today announced that it has passed $20M in annual recurring revenue (ARR) less than two years after launch'. A threshold ('passed $20M'). The release gives no period end date, so this is dated to the Nov 2 announcement. ARR type (gross/net/contracted) not stated, so no basis is set. The headline 'doubles revenue in six months' (from $10M ARR in May 2026) is not recorded as growth_pct: the window is stated in months, and growth_pct needs period_days, which I would only set from a stated day or week count. Company-reported, unaudited. Search-result snippet only; the page was not read (WebFetch was stopped after ENOTFOUND on two other hosts).
